fullPassage:
Let's Celebrate Marine Gardening Day!

A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be (A)[unfamiliar / familiar] with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are (B)[habitats / obstacles] for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have (C)[protected / threatened] marine plants and the other creatures that live on them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌① familiar(익숙한): 원문은 unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은)
✅② unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은)-habitats(서식지)-threatened(위협받다): 모두 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌③ obstacles(장애물): 원문은 habitats(서식지)
❌④ protected(보호하다): 원문은 threatened(위협받다)

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise (A)[ignorance / awareness] of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and (B)[reinforcing / weakening] the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to (C)[preserve / destroy] the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌① ignorance(무지): 원문은 awareness(인식)
❌② weakening(약화시키는): 원문은 reinforcing(강화하는)
❌③ ignorance(무지)·weakening(약화)·destroy(파괴하다) 모두 반대
✅④ awareness(인식)-reinforcing(강화하는)-preserve(보존하다): 모두 원문 ←정답

questions.passage: That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading (A)[contributors / barriers] to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government (B)[designated / abolished] May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌① barriers(장애물): 원문은 contributors(기여자)
❌② abolished(폐지했다)·harvesting(수확하는): 원문은 designated(지정했다)·planting(심는)
✅③ contributors(기여자)-designated(지정했다)-planting(심는): 모두 원문 ←정답
❌④ barriers(장애물)·abolished(폐지)·harvesting(수확) 모두 반대
